title: Dimming Beacon Host
text: Dimming Beacon Host carries a failing navigation lamp whose repair routines overwrite nearby instruments. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Every fix makes the darkness more precise.

defeatReward.text: Dimming Beacon Host is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
